title: Zesty Mediterranean Pita Sandwich
description: A buttery, crumbly sandwich packed with zesty Mediterranean flavors, perfect for a soothing sick-day meal.

ingredients.name: Tahini yogurt sauce
ingredients.notes: mix yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and bake the pita breads until lightly crisp, about 8 minutes.
In a bowl, combine chickpeas, red bell pepper, cucumber, parsley, ground cumin, smoked paprika, and half the salt, stirring until evenly mixed.
Prepare the tahini yogurt sauce by whisking together Greek yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, minced garlic, and the remaining salt until smooth.
Warm the pita breads in the oven for an additional 2 minutes to keep them soft inside.
Spread a generous layer of tahini yogurt sauce onto each pita bread.
Spoon the chickpea mixture evenly over the sauce on each pita.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese and optional crushed red pepper flakes over the chickpeas.
Drizzle a tablespoon of olive oil across the assembled sandwiches.
Fold the pita halves into a sandwich shape and transfer them to individual mini cocottes for served immediately.
